requirement_text: The organization must maintain and execute automated customer data deletion procedures within 30 days.
required_evidence_description: Data deletion procedure policy and verification logs.
evidence_text: All customer data is deleted within 30 days of receiving a verified request, and data deletion procedure verification log records are stored in the compliance audit database.
notes: Exact match with comprehensive policy and execution logs

requirement_text: The organization must implement end-to-end encryption for all customer personal data in transit and at rest.
required_evidence_description: Cryptographic architecture design and encryption key management logs.
evidence_text: All customer personal data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3 across all production endpoints.

requirement_text: Organizations must conduct annual third-party penetration testing on external API gateways.
required_evidence_description: Third-party penetration testing executive summary and remediation report.
evidence_text: Independent security audit firm completed full penetration testing on external API endpoints with zero critical vulnerabilities.

requirement_text: The organization must maintain documented data deletion procedures with quarterly audit logs.
required_evidence_description: Formal data deletion policy and audit logs.
evidence_text: The organization has a draft procedure and preliminary guidelines for deletion, but operational verification logs are currently partial and under development.

requirement_text: The organization must conduct mandatory annual security awareness training for all employees.
required_evidence_description: LMS training completion records and curriculum syllabus.
evidence_text: Security awareness training curriculum has been established; 68% of staff completed the training as of Q3, representing partial completion.

requirement_text: The organization must conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA) prior to deploying biometric AI processing.
required_evidence_description: Completed DPIA signed by DPO and lead architect.
evidence_text: Discussion of theoretical artificial intelligence principles without any formal DPIA document or risk assessment for biometric systems.
notes: Topically related AI whitepaper, but DPIA is missing (False Positive Test 1)

requirement_text: The controller must maintain 24/7 automated security log monitoring with 15-minute alert triage.
required_evidence_description: SOC service level agreement and SIEM monitoring configurations.
evidence_text: Physical security guards monitor building entry turnstiles and visitor badges during regular business hours from 8 AM to 6 PM.
notes: Physical security document provided for digital SIEM monitoring obligation (False Positive Test 2)

requirement_text: The organization must perform quarterly vulnerability assessments on all internal subnets and external firewalls.
required_evidence_description: Vulnerability scanning reports covering internal subnets and perimeter firewalls.
evidence_text: Network security team executes quarterly vulnerability scans on external firewalls, while internal subnet scanning is performed semi-annually with partial scope coverage.
notes: External scans complete but internal subnet scanning interval is partial

requirement_text: Production databases must replicate asynchronously to a secondary geographical region with under 15-minute Recovery Point Objective (RPO).
required_evidence_description: Database replication architecture and cross-region RPO monitoring logs.
evidence_text: Production MySQL instances replicate to secondary availability zones in the primary region; disaster recovery cross-region replication is in draft architecture phase.
notes: Local zone replication in place but cross-region replication is only draft

requirement_text: The organization must conduct independent third-party penetration testing on cloud infrastructure annually.
required_evidence_description: Third-party penetration testing report from an accredited external security firm.
evidence_text: Junior DevOps engineer executed a free open-source port scanner on localhost and completed an internal self-audit checklist without external auditor verification.
notes: Internal scan fails the mandatory third-party independent audit requirement

requirement_text: Mandatory annual cybersecurity awareness training must be completed by 100% of full-time and contractor staff.
required_evidence_description: Training completion audit report with verified 100% attendance tracking.
evidence_text: HR sent an email announcement with a link to an optional cybersecurity recording; no attendance tracking, completion quiz, or mandatory compliance enforcement exists.
notes: Optional email announcement fails mandatory training completion obligation

requirement_text: The organization must maintain automated, immutable, write-once-read-many (WORM) offsite backups for customer financial ledgers.
required_evidence_description: Cloud immutable storage bucket configuration and automated backup logs.
evidence_text: Accounting assistant manually copies monthly accounting spreadsheets onto an unencrypted portable USB flash drive kept in the office filing cabinet.
notes: Manual unencrypted USB copy fails automated offsite immutable backup requirement

requirement_text: The controller must maintain an incident response SLA guaranteeing regulatory notification of high-risk data breaches within 72 hours.
required_evidence_description: Incident response SLA policy and breach notification workflow procedures.
evidence_text: Tier-1 customer service representatives are expected to respond to customer password reset requests within 4 hours and general queries within 24 hours.
notes: Helpdesk ticketing response SLA provided instead of regulatory breach notification SLA

requirement_text: Organizations must enforce TLS 1.3 protocol encryption for all external web traffic and disable deprecated SSLv3, TLS 1.0, and TLS 1.1 ciphers.
required_evidence_description: Web server TLS cipher suite configuration standard and SSL Labs audit verification.
evidence_text: All production ingress load balancers enforce TLS 1.3 protocol encryption with modern forward-secrecy cipher suites, and legacy protocols SSLv3, TLS 1.0, and TLS 1.1 are explicitly disabled.
notes: Directly satisfies TLS 1.3 and cipher decommissioning requirement
